def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the non-background 4x4 motif and blank target rectangle.
    bg=grid[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,0)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    motif=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    target=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    tr0=min(r for r,c in target); tr1=max(r for r,c in target)
    tc0=min(c for r,c in target); tc1=max(c for r,c in target)
    # Reflect motif horizontally, then copy into target tile.
    for i,r in enumerate(range(tr0,tr1+1)):
        for j,c in enumerate(range(tc0,tc1+1)):
            g[r][c]=motif[i][c1-c0-j]
    return g
PY
